notes.title: 🦊 Harmony in the Wild: New Demo! 🌿
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurer! ✨

We're excited to share with you that our game Harmony in the Wild has a NEW demo! 🧡

🎮 You can try it out for the first time, or if you're a returning player discover all these new features:

[list]
[*] New Weather system - it might get chilly!
[*] New day/night cycles - the sunset is best enjoyed in the flower field.
[*] Updated UI - easier to navigate.
[*] Improved graphics - explore the vibrant forest!
[*] New music - it's even more soothing.
[*] More collectibles - crystals and runes bring the magic to your adventure!
[/list]
Let's restore nature's balance and bring it back to life!

We would love to hear your thoughts! Join our community [url=https://discord.gg/yuTHUTqSuA]Discord[/url] server to share your feedback. Your input will help us improve Harmony in the Wild!

Thank you for your support! 🥰

🦊 P.S. Wishlist Harmony in the Wild to get updates & be the first to know about our upcoming release! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360850/Harmony_in_the_Wild

notes.title: 🎮 Harmony in the Wild – New Demo Out Now! 🌿
notes.notes:
🦊[b] Step into the wild – the new demo is LIVE! [/b]🌿✨

The latest version of Harmony in the Wild is here, bringing a more beautiful and immersive experience than ever before! Whether you're a returning player or discovering the game for the first time, now’s the perfect time to explore the world of Harmony and wishlist our upcoming release!

Thank you for your help <3

🔥 What’s New in the Demo? (Our nature is not on fire)
✅ Breathtaking new VFX – waterfalls, northern lights, and glowing bioluminescent plants.
✅ New abilities – take a swim in the night, glide across terrains, charge jump, freeze & smash!
✅ More world to explore – collectables and animated wildlife to interact with.
✅ Immersive atmosphere – dynamic music and animations bring the world to life.

🐾 This is just the beginning – wishlist now to follow our journey!

Try the demo and let us know what you think! 
We want to create an experience all of us would enjoy so your input is more than valuable.
Your support helps us make Harmony in the Wild the best it can be. 💙
